attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured PAM limits (nofile 8192, nproc 256 soft/hard) via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, verified effective via a login shell. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot id and healthy state, issued a native reboot, confirmed the boot id changed after reconnecting, and re-verified account, config file, and effective limits post-restart.
